title: 38: Making Appointments

sentences.translation: Good day, I would like to make an appointment.
sentences.targetText: Guten Tag, ich möchte einen Termin machen.

sentences.translation: Unfortunately we don't have an appointment free on Thursday.
sentences.audioText: Am Donnerstag haben wir leider keinen Termin frei.

sentences.translation: And on Friday? Do you have something available then?
sentences.targetText: Und am Freitag? Haben Sie da noch etwas frei?

sentences.translation: On Friday at ten thirty there would be an appointment free.
sentences.translationFa: جمعه ساعت ده و نیم یک وقت خالی هست.
sentences.audioText: Am Freitag um zehn Uhr dreißig wäre ein Termin frei.

sentences.translation: That suits me well. I will be there on time.
sentences.translationFa: برایم مناسب است. سر وقت خواهم آمد.
sentences.targetText: Das passt mir gut. Ich werde pünktlich da sein.

sentences.translation: Good, Mr. Ahmadi. We will expect you on Friday.
sentences.translationFa: خوب، آقای احمدی. جمعه منتظرتان خواهیم بود.
sentences.audioText: Gut, Herr Ahmadi. Wir werden Sie am Freitag erwarten.

sentences.translation: Thank you very much! See you Friday!

description: You're not feeling well and a colleague notices. Explain your symptoms and decide what to do.
descriptionFa: حالتون خوب نیست و یه همکار متوجه می‌شه. علائمتون رو توضیح بدید و تصمیم بگیرید چیکار کنید.
